description: Rule-based Shariah (Islamic finance) compliance screen for US-listed companies. Applies AAOIFI-style screening using authoritative SEC financials: (1) business-activity screen (flags alcohol, tobacco, gambling, conventional banking/insurance, pork, weapons, adult), (2) financial ratio screens (debt/assets <33%, liquid+interest/assets <33%, receivables/assets <49%). Returns verdict (compliant / non_compliant / questionable) with the exact failing test and ratios. Pay per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

ticker.description: US-listed ticker to screen, e.g. AAPL, XOM, JPM.

name: hsh-shariah-screen
